title: VPS Install + Setup
description: Copy bundle to VPS and run Vrooli setup in a predictable layout.

requirements.title: Install bundle and run setup
requirements.description: Copy the mini-Vrooli tarball to the VPS, extract it into the deployment workdir, upload a deployment-local native vrooli CLI to <workdir>/.vrooli/bin/vrooli, run `vrooli setup --yes yes --environment production` through that exact binary, configure autoheal scope, and verify the deployment-local CLI is functional.

validation.notes: Covers step order plus deployment-local native CLI setup/verify commands. Tag tests with [REQ:STC-P0-004].
Disposable-VPS smoke should verify native CLI upload, `vrooli setup --yes yes --environment production`, and deployment-local `vrooli --version`. Tag with [REQ:STC-P0-004].

requirements.title: Autoheal scope configured for mini-Vrooli
requirements.description: Deployment writes a scoped config so vrooli-autoheal monitors only the deployed scenario/resources and core lifecycle health signals.
